notes.title: Regarding the Release date
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

To those of you who have been looking forward to playing Live Hard, Die Hard, 
we apologize for not updating you for a while!
But rest assured that development is progressing steadily 🧠

This year, we were given the privilege to participate in various game shows worldwide, 
and we have been carefully observing the reactions of the people who have played the demo. 
We were so inspired by your feedback and realized how much of an improvement 
we can make to offer a much more spectacular gaming experience.

However, this means we need a bit more time to bring our dream game to life.
Therefore, we would like to update the release date to 2025.

Imagine the eccentric doctor brewing strange concoctions... 
pushing soldiers beyond their limits in ways that defy belief…
An intense, unforgettable experience packed with thrilling, dark twists is on its way!

We'll be sharing more updates on these improvements starting next year, 
so get ready for a thrilling surprise! 

Thanks all for your continued support for Live Hard, Die Hard !💣
